items.name: Steps
items.description: A stretch of movement as Apple measured it: how many steps, whether walking or running, and when it began and ended. Every field is optional.
items.author: cd06737794176d6a784c

items.name: Evening Questions
items.description: Three questions for the end of a day.
items.author: cd06737794176d6a784c

items.name: State of Mind
items.description: One State of Mind as Apple records it: whether it was a moment or a day, how pleasant it was, the feelings the person named and what they associated with them. Every field is optional. The valence is kept as the person gave it and is not drawn.
items.author: cd06737794176d6a784c

items.name: Standard
items.description: The look every journal has: a 16 point body on a 22 point line, two blocks 10 points apart, bold headings, a quote with a bar, a list of bullets, and the day's number beside its date. Every property is written out here, so this file is also the list of what a style may set.
items.author: cd06737794176d6a784c

items.name: Drama
items.description: A magazine page: big headings, a pull quote and room to breathe.
items.author: cd06737794176d6a784c

items.name: Quiet
items.description: A notebook: the space does the work, and the number and the first heading are given a voice of their own.
items.author: cd06737794176d6a784c

items.name: Number
items.description: The day's number leads the page, and each entry's time leads the entry.
items.author: cd06737794176d6a784c

items.name: Workout
items.description: One workout as Apple records it: what kind it was, when it began and ended, and the numbers a watch or phone measured. Every field is optional, because a workout carries only what its device measured. A route is a GPX file attached to the record's entry and is not a field.
items.author: cd06737794176d6a784c
